description: Land Acquisition - Battaramulla, Kaduwela D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire two allotments of land for public purpose, provides detailed descriptions of the properties (including location, extent, and claimant information), and outlines the legal process for interested parties to make compensation claims. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition and property matters.
